classification: NEW CONDITIONAL DELAY INTERFACE, not native propagation

types.source: M and C are separate ordered triples. W_v=A v is a virtual polar registered vector; T is the fixed linear blend.
types.calibration: One fixed global A=lambda_g Rz(delta), lambda_g>0; no fitted value needed for transfer-law comparisons in W coordinates
types.clocks: Analysis time t, native iteration and supplied source readout clock remain distinct. No native interpolation rule adopted.
types.speed: c_*>0 symbolic, shell widths per analysis-time unit; not identified with a native constant or light speed

interface.K: G^-1 sum_a n_a n_a^T exp(-i omega d_a/c_*)

parameter_families.H: h=+h2,+h1,0,-h1,-h2 with 0<h1<h2; R_m,s_m>0, phi_m0 declared; matched R,s,angles for reflection controls
parameter_families.R: R1<R2<R3 at common h, matched s and angular offsets
parameter_families.combined: h_l in {h2,h1,0,-h1,-h2}; R_l,r and s_l,r positive, phi_l,r,0 declared; apply pairwise clearance inequalities; no coordinates generated
parameter_families.reflection: Equal upper/lower R,s,phi0 reflects centres and enclosing balls. Same B does not automatically reflect full folded shells; no corrective twist adopted.

full_module_reconstruction: Every probe is all 18 retained vertices and all three full faces transformed by the placement formula; enclosing balls contain the full polygons by the retained convexity bound

signal_tests.constant: W=w0: F=W at every site and speed
signal_tests.harmonic: W=Re(w_hat exp(i omega t)); formal calibration input, not a native orbit
signal_tests.onset: Prescribed W(t)=w0 H(t) with zero prehistory for earliest-distance interpretation; active-input and projection qualifications apply
signal_tests.phase_fixture: nu=omega*a/c_*=pi/2 only for the three radial numeric gain checks

model_storage: E=1/2 integral_0^d u^2 ds; dE/dt=c_*/2 (q(t)^2-q(t-d/c_*)^2); no native energy identification
